policy.resident_hit: ordinary baseline timestamp publication, no new policy state or policy charge
policy.replacement: ordinary baseline least timestamp, then lowest slot; exclude pinned and previously selected residents
policy.miss: observe original 512-cell count-plan identity before complete scan can replace it; a valid matching plan admits at current work timestamp, otherwise admit with replacement timestamp zero
policy.zero_timestamp: reserved cold replacement priority, not a claim of actual last access time; first resident hit publishes ordinary current work timestamp
policy.identity: function, body offset, body length, type index must all match; a matching function with mismatched immutable body identity fails closed
policy.failure: observation has no new persistent state; complete scans retain baseline publication; successful evictions remain after build failure; no partial new resident publication
policy.fallback: a plan collision is a cold observation, never a proof or validation bypass

schedule: 2 for prepared identity-observation tag and classification
2 for prepared insertion value and phase transfer
2 for miss-only timestamp choice and validation
2 for precharged success publication of insertion value
fixed_work_schedule.scope: Authored additional logical policy credits, not measured VM CacheWork; no added victim scan; unchanged complete decode/build and existing work remain required. Same 8-credit bound is charged to both cold control policies for conservative simple comparison; escape-control state cost is not proposed for product integration.

bounded_experiment.fixed_traces: exact six retained synthetic access sequences plus resident-hit256
bounded_experiment.adversarial: plan collisions, scan larger than plan table, working-set phase turnover, cold first-use burst, ties, variable sizes, pins, failure, timestamp boundary, every capacity 0 through 64
bounded_experiment.native_or_full_target: unselected and prohibited by this experiment

selection_gate: Recommend only a separately selected finite implementation if the evidence supports it; never select integration or a full-target run. Material phase or collision regressions must be explicit.
